task: SM70 V100 numerical simulation and structure-guided low-precision packing exploration

models.cycle_model_configuration: upstream SM7_QV100; not calibrated to user Tesla V100

scope: Published hardware fixtures were supplied by the model authors; these are not fresh measurements on the user computer.
Numerical and cycle models are separate. Accel-Sim synthetic traces contain no arithmetic data or packing correctness results.
No dynamic trace of the new packing kernels was obtained; their evidence is compilation and static cost.
Full-range MXFP4 packing, end-to-end speedup, convergence and training usefulness remain unestablished.
The original GPU probe is supplied as pending hardware work; the new m8n8k4 program is a compile/layout-register probe only.
